mapper.select: SELECT id,conversation_id,message_id,max_slots,active_count,status,deadline_at,version FROM im_chain WHERE id=#{chainId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,chain_id,member_id,content,position,status,request_id,version FROM im_chain_entry WHERE chain_id=#{chainId} AND member_id=#{memberId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT receipt_id,chain_id,conversation_id,member_id,request_id,action,content, expected_chain_version,expected_entry_version,expected_active_count,next_active_count,effect FROM im_chain_command_receipt WHERE chain_id=#{chainId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_chain SET active_count=#{proposal.nextActiveCount}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{proposal.chainId} AND conversation_id=#{proposal.conversationId} AND version=#{proposal.expectedChainVersion} AND version < 9223372036854775807 AND active_count=#{proposal.expectedActiveCount} AND #{proposal.nextActiveCount} BETWEEN 0 AND max_slots AND ((#{proposal.effect} IN ('INSERT_RELATION','REACTIVATE_RELATION') AND #{proposal.nextActiveCount}=active_count+1 AND status='OPEN' AND UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) < deadline_at) OR (#{proposal.effect}='WITHDRAW_RELATION' AND #{proposal.nextActiveCount}=active_count-1))

UPDATE im_chain_entry SET
status='ACTIVE', content=#{command.content}, status='WITHDRAWN',
request_id=#{command.requestId}, version=version+1 WHERE chain_id=#{proposal.chainId} AND member_id=#{proposal.memberId} AND chain_id=#{command.chainId} AND member_id=#{command.memberId} AND #{proposal.conversationId}=#{command.conversationId} AND version=#{proposal.expectedEntryVersion} AND version < 9223372036854775807
AND status='WITHDRAWN' AND #{command.action}='JOIN' AND status='ACTIVE' AND #{command.action}='WITHDRAW' AND 1=0
